# Nell Harcourt

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty-five years of age  <sub>[v4 c2 P11](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c8 P1](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0001), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v4 c2 P11](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0011), [v4 c35 P10](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher and writer  <sub>[v2 c11 P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 c26 P24](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0024), [v3 c16 P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002)</sub>

- **Nicknames:** Nell of Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c20 P12](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0012)</sub>; Lucinda  <sub>[v3 c12 P10](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Nell is a tall, slender woman with milk-white skin, a small pointed chin, and a pleasant, freckled nose. She has striking gray eyes that shift in shade and bright, thick hair varying from red to ginger and Titian auburn. Her countenance is expressive and bright, often flushed with rosy color when excited.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P55](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0055), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c25 P0](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0000), [v1 c33 P43](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0043), [v2 c27 P41](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0041), [v3 c41 P15](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0015), [v4 c1 P25](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0025), [v4 c12 P21](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0021), [v4 c31 P16](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0016)_

## Personality

Nell possesses a vivid imagination, a passionate nature, and a tendency to drift into romantic reveries and daydreams. Though cheerful, optimistic, and deeply unselfish, she can be impetuous, stubborn, and quick-tempered when provoked. She harbors strong affections as well as persistent animosities, especially when her pride is stung. Her high expectations often leave her vulnerable to intense emotions, but her resolute determination enables her to overcome hardship.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c7 P2](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0002), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c33 P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v2 c10 P4](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0004), [v2 c26 P24](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0024)_

- To secure the Thorburn Scholarship in English  <sub>[v3 c9 P0](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0000)</sub>
- To obtain a degree from Wexcombe College without burdening her guardians' savings  <sub>[v3 c2 P11](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0011), [v3 c9 P0](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0000)</sub>
- To bring beauty and improvement into her community  <sub>[v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008)</sub>

## History

After being taken from the Marden orphan asylum by Thirza and Obed Abernethy, Nell settled into life at Grey Shutters in Brierley. She attended the local school, where she developed a passionate academic rivalry with Hugh Carrow and formed a deep, lifelong friendship with Isolde Pembroke. Nell later studied for her teacher's license at Regent's Academy and subsequently taught school in Brierley while co-founding the Brierley Village Improvement Society. She pursued higher education at Wexcombe College, excelling in English and winning a prize for her creative writing. Following her studies, she returned to her ties in Brierley and married Hugh Carrow.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c11 P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v3 c4 P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 c9 P0](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0000), [v3 c16 P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002), [v4 c2 P11](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0011), [v4 c8 P54](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0054)_

## Background by volume

- Born in Harborough, Nova Scotia to Edmund and Bertha Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- Orphaned as an infant when both parents died of fever  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Raised by Mrs. Thomas until age eight, assisting with her younger children  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Lived upriver with Mrs. Rudge for over two years caring for her children  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Briefly stayed at an orphan asylum in Marden before being taken in by Thirza Abernethy and Obed Abernethy  <sub>[v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
- Raised at Grey Shutters in Brierley for fourteen years  <sub>[v1 c20 P12](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0012), [v2 c10 P4](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0004)</sub>
